# Deterministic Output 2 BER test bit stream
#
# Mapping:
#   0 -> 428.391 kHz
#   1 -> 450.391 kHz
#
# ARB sample rate: 10 MSa/s
# Basic stored cell: 200 samples = 20 us
#
# Stage 1:
#   2500 stored cells = exactly 50 ms.
#   Five zero cells followed by five one cells, repeated 250 times.
#   Each frequency level is therefore held for 5 * 20 us = 100 us.
#   Frame time: 0.000 ms <= t < 50.000 ms
#
# Stage 2:
#   100 alternating training bits = 2.00 ms
#   32-bit sync word 0x1ACFFC1D = 0.64 ms
#   2368-bit PRBS15 payload = 47.36 ms
#   Total = 2500 bits = exactly 50 ms
#   Frame time: 50.000 ms <= t < 100.000 ms
#
# Detailed frame timeline:
#   Stage 1, 100-us alternating levels:
#     duration 50.000 ms; frame time 0.000 to 50.000 ms
#   Stage 2 training, 100 bits at 20 us/bit:
#     duration 2.000 ms; Stage-2 time 0.000 to 2.000 ms;
#     frame time 50.000 to 52.000 ms
#   Stage 2 sync, 32 bits at 20 us/bit:
#     duration 0.640 ms; Stage-2 time 2.000 to 2.640 ms;
#     frame time 52.000 to 52.640 ms
#   Stage 2 PRBS15 payload, 2368 bits at 20 us/bit:
#     duration 47.360 ms; Stage-2 time 2.640 to 50.000 ms;
#     frame time 52.640 to 100.000 ms
#   Final 428.391-kHz hold:
#     begins after frame time 100.000 ms and repeats indefinitely
#
# Header definition (132 bits total):
#   header = 100-bit training + 32-bit sync word
# Header bits (transmitted left to right):
#   010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010100011010110011111111110000011101
#
# Payload generator:
#   Polynomial: x^15 + x^14 + 1
#   Initial nonzero seed: 0x4ACE
#   Output bit: lfsr[14] (MSB first)
#   Update: lfsr <= {lfsr[13:0], lfsr[14] XOR lfsr[13]}
#
# For BER, locate the sync word, then compare the following 2368 decoded bits
# with STAGE2_PAYLOAD_BITS. Ignore the training and sync bits in the BER count.

[STAGE1_100US_CELL_BITS]

[STAGE2_TRAINING_BITS]
# Duration: 2.000 ms; frame time: 50.000 to 52.000 ms
# 100 bits at 20 us/bit
0101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101

# 32 bits at 20 us/bit; hexadecimal value: 0x1ACFFC1D
00011010110011111111110000011101
